A pass can admit only this exact source to a later same-basis common-scalar/KKT gate; it cannot establish chemical accuracy.

Do not change the radial data, select a subset of points, add induced monopoles/higher multipoles, rescale/clip/symmetrize the raw MACE-MDP response, refit atomic weights, use a solvation label, or run an accuracy panel. A pass permits only a separately preregistered same-basis common-scalar/KKT, continuum-duality, and force gate; it does not make the source a final molecular density representation or a total solvation method.
